name: SLAB
description: Third Coast playback moods: Screwed, Chopped, Slowed + Reverb and more, with pads that chop and loop on the bar and run the vocal line back, and a DJ mode that works the record on full screw by itself. On macOS the free SLAB helper makes it real: true pitch and reverb, instant chops, hold-to-screw, trunk and echo, and a tape bank with wow, hiss and crackle.
